The buttons on this page play the 30-second previews from other places than the wiki's own file pages. The page has play buttons only, no players.

Today's pick: Ripple <playbutton title="Ripple" hidemissing="yes">http://127.0.0.1:8144/media/Ripple.mp3</playbutton>

== Mirror ==
The mirror at <code>http://127.0.0.1:8144/media/</code> keeps a copy of the songs. The wiki may ask the mirror whether a file exists before anyone presses play, so a button with <code>hidemissing="yes"</code> disappears when the mirror does not have its file.

<tabber>
|-|Galaxy Triangle=
{| class="wikitable"
! # !! Song !! Preview
|-
| 4 || Ripple || <playbutton title="Ripple" hidemissing="yes">http://127.0.0.1:8144/media/Ripple.mp3</playbutton>
|-
| 7 || E Div. || <playbutton title="E Div." hidemissing="yes">http://127.0.0.1:8144/media/E%20Div..mp3</playbutton>
|}
The mirror calls the last song <code>E Div.mp3</code>. The button for E Div. adds <code>.mp3</code> to the title instead, so the mirror has no such file and the button stays hidden.
|-|Singles=
Mukyu Platonic by VALIS <playbutton title="Mukyu Platonic" hidemissing="yes">http://127.0.0.1:8144/media/Mukyu%20Platonic.mp3</playbutton>
</tabber>

== Another site ==
This site does not let the wiki read its files (no CORS), so the wiki never asks it about a file before you press play and the button always shows. The song still plays.

Galactic Love <playbutton title="Galactic Love" hidemissing="yes">http://127.0.0.1:8145/media/Galactic%20Love.mp3</playbutton>
